scope: Shared permission-controlled macOS command runner; no provider, account or project permission changes.
confirmed_causes: Saved pip failure occurred in _create_truststore_ssl_context -> load_verify_locations(certifi.where()), before a database connection.
The blanket .pem read denial included the installed public CA bundle. Homebrew follows cacert.pem through its Cellar to /opt/homebrew/etc/ca-certificates/cert.pem.
Once certificate reads worked, a live public-index test showed that external-network permission omitted native DNS service access.
After DNS worked, native certificate evaluation failed with OSStatus -26276 until the approved network profile could reach com.apple.trustd and com.apple.trustd.agent.
changes: Discover public certificate bundles from supported installation paths and isolated standard-library Python metadata. No project Python imports or inherited credential environment.
Validate bounded X.509 certificate-only PEM contents and every trusted symlink target. Grant exact read paths only. Reject user/project lookalikes and preserve private-key and keychain denials.
Permit DNS and native trust evaluation only when an existing external-network or loopback/local-server authorization applies.

Return structured certificate initialization vs TLS verification diagnostics. Shared tool guidance no longer recommends broader filesystem permissions or disabling TLS for protected certificate reads.

verification.before: Actual sandbox test reproduced the same PermissionError without installation or network access.
verification.after: Installed pip trust-store initialization succeeds and retains CERT_REQUIRED.
verification.real_https: pip index versions pg8000 against https://pypi.org/simple succeeded inside the actual sandbox; no package installation.
verification.local_tls: A disposable HTTPS fixture rejected an untrusted certificate and accepted a test leaf certificate only with its explicitly supplied CA. The test did not modify system trust.
verification.restrictions: Private PEMs, project PEMs, symlink escapes, writes to the public bundle, and offline network requests remain denied.
verification.focused_tests: 53 passed, 2 optional tests skipped across command, permission, project-write and Full Access suites.
verification.agent_regressions: 67 passed, 1 optional test skipped across agent tools and replay protection.
verification.optional_legacy_failure: An additional ATHENA_SANDBOX_TEST Git-commit fixture fails because it externally pre-stages files, while the pre-existing HEAD implementation requires staging by the current execution. This restriction and test were not changed.
verification.build: TypeScript check and production build passed; existing bundle-size warnings only.
verification.package: macOS ARM64 package succeeded; app and four helpers signed and verified with the persistent local certificate. Packaged main-process code contains the new policy and diagnostics. Apple notarization was unavailable without deployment credentials.
verification.restart: Verified normal Athena restarted from PID 38529 to 69140. Companion ready and saved conversations visible. No other applications were stopped.

not_performed: Original dependency installation was not retried.
No live database access or credential use.
No changes to user permissions, TLS verification, project files, Git state or provider selection.
No Windows live test; the existing command sandbox is macOS-specific.
